analysis.cross_validation: Hold complete geometry out; include pairing within worker/q; never train on D1.
analysis.identification: B_tile/transfer are separately reported only if matched controls and held-geometry tests support a common additive decomposition; otherwise retain a set/bound and declare nonidentification.
analysis.local_semantics: All variants share BF16 state update, final-state observation and identical checksum consumer for each fixed (R,p,columns). Across p the intended local grouping changes; differences are net subgraph costs, not naked opcode latency.
analysis.packed_contrast: native vs exact positive scale before wide max, with corresponding fixture vs fixture_wide controls; inspect final lowering and retain extra-operation costs.
analysis.transfer_scope: Fresh-origin repeated TMA plus mandatory slot-reuse barrier; not pure hardware TMA latency. Full-footprint K1 controls measure small-BM behavior.
analysis.units: ns/tile/SM from grid slope; global launch intercept kept separate
